description.value: Kawartha Dairy is a 100% Canadian, family-owned dairy company founded in 1937 in Bobcaygeon, Ontario, known for rich, creamy ice cream made with fresh milk and cream from Canadian farms. Their Britannia Beach location brings a beloved Ontario institution to BC's Sea-to-Sky corridor, making it a natural sugar stop for cyclists on the route between Squamish and Vancouver. With over 85 years of craftsmanship, the brand is well-regarded across Canada for its distinctive premium flavours.
